description: This file declares an interface class IFactories within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. The class provides virtual methods for creating proxy objects related to web requests, responses, file handling, and JSON RPC messaging. It also includes static methods for managing an instance of the interface and checking availability.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface providing factory methods for creating web request and response objects, file bodies, and JSON RPC messages, along with static methods for managing its singleton instance.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy object representing a web request.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy object representing a web response.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy object representing a web file body.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy object representing a JSON RPC message.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns an instance of IFactories as the singleton instance.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IFactories instance is available.
